# Wattlebooks

> Wattlebooks is a free, open-source invoicing app for sole traders and small businesses. It runs on Windows 10 and 11, Linux and macOS (as a preview), keeps your books in a folder on your own computer and follows the GST, VAT or sales tax rules of Australia, New Zealand, the UK, Canada and the US.

- Price: free. No subscription, no per-invoice fee, no paid plan and no ads. MIT licence.
- Made for: tradies, freelancers and other sole traders, first in Australia.
- Install: a single file with nothing to install. The latest version is {version}.
- Privacy: nothing goes online unless you sign in to the optional phone app. Then only open invoices, recent payments and client names are shared with your phone.
- Former name: InvoiceDesk. The download is now Wattlebooks.exe, and the data folder is still called InvoiceDesk.

## What it does

- Tax invoices with the heading your country expects (TAX INVOICE, VAT INVOICE), your tax number and tax per line, on A4 or US Letter.
- Quotes that turn into invoices, and invoices that repeat weekly, fortnightly, monthly, quarterly or yearly.
- Email an invoice as a PDF, and chase late payers with a friendly, firm or final reminder.
- Statements of everything a client owes, aged into 30, 60 and 90 days.
- Payments, other income and expenses, with receipts attached.
- Receipt scanning: drop a photo or PDF of a receipt and it fills in the supplier, date, amount and tax. Uses the text reader built into Windows, so the receipt never leaves the computer. Windows only.
- A dashboard of unpaid invoices by due date, this month's cash book and profit for the tax year.
- Reports with your country's tax return worksheet and a profit and loss for any period, saved as PDF or CSV.
- Bill clients anywhere in 13 currencies: AUD, NZD, GBP, CAD, USD, EUR, SGD, HKD, CHF, SEK, NOK, DKK and ZAR.
- An optional phone app (a free pilot) for snapping receipts, starting quick invoices and seeing who owes you.

## Tax by country

| Country | Tax | Tax return figures |
|---|---|---|
| Australia | GST 10%, ABN | BAS worksheet (G1, 1A, 1B) |
| New Zealand | GST 15% | GST return (boxes 5 to 15) |
| United Kingdom | VAT at 20%, 5%, 0% or exempt | VAT return (boxes 1 to 9) |
| Canada | GST or HST by province | GST/HST return |
| United States | Sales tax at your rate | Sales tax summary |

## What it doesn't do

- No payroll and no bank feeds. Xero, MYOB or QuickBooks are a better fit if you need those.
- It doesn't lodge your BAS or tax return. It works out the figures for you to copy across.
- Quebec QST and the provincial sales taxes in BC, Saskatchewan and Manitoba aren't covered yet.
- It isn't tax advice. Check your figures with your accountant or tax office if you're unsure.
- The Microsoft Store copy is signed by Microsoft. The plain Windows .exe isn't code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn about it. Click More info, then Run anyway.
